scientific_limitations: Discrete-time birth–death Moran updating, connected simple undirected unweighted graphs, one initial mutant, conditional fixation moments only.
The universal classification is only through three vertices. The four-vertex witness is at mutant fitness 5; its complete fitness phase diagram is not claimed.
Independent audit and empirical validation have not been performed.
title: Four sites suffice for mean–variance disagreement in conditional Moran fixation time
